title: 800,000 Users Pre-ordered for a一刀切: Google Cuts AI Studio as a Standalone App and Fully Integrates It into Gemini

content_html:
Google is well-known for frequently discontinuing products, but this time even an application that had not yet officially launched was not spared. The standalone mobile application Google AI Studio, which made a stunning debut at this year's Google I/O, was officially announced to be completely canceled just before its official release—despite having attracted pre-orders from approximately 800,000 users in 168 countries around the world on the App Store and Google Play.

According to the original plan, the app was supposed to be available on Android and iOS platforms, allowing developers and creators to capture inspiration anytime and anywhere, and build, test, iterate, and even launch AI apps directly on their phones. The Google AI Studio team explained on social media that instead of asking users to "download another new standalone app," they chose a completely different strategic approach—integrating the core features directly into the Gemini main app.

Not giving up, but making Gemini a versatile hub

The features were not completely abandoned, but rather embedded into the Gemini app on both mobile and desktop through deep collaboration with the Gemini team. Google's intention is clear: to turn Gemini into a comprehensive core hub, so that the creation and prototyping of AI apps no longer remain limited to standalone developer tools, but can "naturally emerge" during everyday smart conversations. In the future, both ordinary consumers and developers are expected to seamlessly gain customized app development experiences through daily interactions with Gemini.

For the 800,000 users who have already pre-ordered, although they can no longer download the standalone AI Studio client, the official has promised that the underlying features will eventually be realized in the iterations of Gemini. At the same time, the web version of Google AI Studio will continue to be retained and operate independently, continuously receiving Google's investment and upgrades, serving as a core platform for professional developers and creators to move from creativity to commercialization. From a standalone app to being integrated into the main app, Google's choice reflects an industry trend—the era when AI assistants themselves can generate apps may ultimately lead to the demise of standalone developer tools, replaced by a new paradigm where "conversation is development."

content_html_zh:
谷歌以频繁停产产品而闻名，但这一次，连一款尚未正式推出的应用程序也未能幸免。 在今年的 Google I/O 大会上惊艳亮相的独立移动应用 Google AI Studio，尽管在 App Store 和 Google Play 上吸引了全球 168 个国家约 80 万用户的预订，但在正式发布之前却被正式宣布彻底取消。

按照最初的计划，该应用程序应该在 Android 和 iOS 平台上运行，让开发者和创作者随时随地捕捉灵感，并直接在手机上构建、测试、迭代甚至推出 AI 应用程序。 Google AI Studio 团队在社交媒体上解释说，他们没有要求用户“下载另一个新的独立应用程序”，而是选择了完全不同的战略方法——将核心功能直接集成到 Gemini 主应用程序中。

不放弃，而是让双子座成为一个多功能的枢纽

这些功能并没有完全放弃，而是通过与 Gemini 团队的深度合作嵌入到移动和桌面上的 Gemini 应用程序中。 谷歌的意图很明确：将 Gemini 打造成一个综合性的核心枢纽，让 AI 应用的创建和原型设计不再局限于独立的开发者工具，而是可以在日常智能对话中“自然而然地出现”。 未来，无论是普通消费者还是开发者都有望通过与Gemini的日常互动，无缝地获得定制化的应用开发体验。

对于已经预购的80万用户，虽然无法再下载独立的AI Studio客户端，但官方承诺底层功能最终会在Gemini的迭代中实现。 同时，网页版Google AI Studio将继续保留并独立运营，持续接受谷歌的投资和升级，作为专业开发者和创作者从创意走向商业化的核心平台。 从独立应用程序到集成到主应用程序中，谷歌的选择反映了一种行业趋势——人工智能助手本身可以生成应用程序的时代可能最终导致独立开发工具的消亡，取而代之的是“对话即开发”的新范式。
